chat_say.description: Send a message to Factorio chat as a companion

companion_list.description: List ALL companions with positions and health

companion_position.description: Get companion position and nearby entities

companion_stop.description: Stop all queues for a companion (harvest, craft, build, combat, walk)

resource_nearest.description: Find nearest resource of a type

resource_mine.description: Start mining at coordinates (companion must be within 5 tiles)

resource_mine_stop.description: Stop the active native mining queue

item_pick.description: Pick up items from ground near companion

world_nearest.description: Find nearest entity of a type

building_mine.description: Mine (destroy) any entity at coordinates - works on crash site wrecks, decoratives

building_can_place.description: Check if entity can be placed at coordinates

building_fuel.description: Add fuel to nearby entity (burner, furnace, etc) - companion must be within 3 tiles

building_empty.description: Extract items from nearby entity into companion inventory (radius 5)

building_fill.description: Fill nearby entity with items from companion inventory (radius 3)

help.description: Get help and list of commands

world_observe.description: Read a bounded world snapshot: players, companions, inventories, nearby machines/resources/enemies, terrain, research and errors. Only charted chunks. Works before spawning a companion.

companionId.description: 0: first connected player or spawn; otherwise companion ID

gather.description: Autonomously find reachable resources, walk and mine the requested number of NEW items. Poll gather_status; do not issue movement while active.

exclude.description: Ore tiles to skip while gathering.

gather_status.description: Read gather progress and terminal result

fuel_group.description: Walk to nearby burners and supply coal from inventory

mine_diag.description: Read native mining diagnostics for a stuck companion

task_submit.description: Submit a bounded sequence of native task steps. Supported: ensure_item, find_patch, verify_tile, pick_orientation, place, fuel, remove, find_existing, set_position, read_drop_position. Check task_status after submission.

oneOf.description: Acquire a total carried item count through available materials, crafting or gathering.
Find an ore patch and save its position as primary.
Verify the primary position still contains this resource.
Choose a collision-free layout around the primary position. Requires clear ground.
Walk, clear natural obstacles and place an item from carried inventory.

mirror.description: Mirror the placed entity when supported by Factorio.

oneOf.description: Insert fuel into burners near the target position.
Mine a specific building into carried inventory.
Use the nearest existing named building as the primary position.
Set the primary position for following steps.
Read a building output position for a following step.ref.

task_status.description: Read task progress, material needs and outcome

task_pool_diag.description: Inspect task ownership, reservations and queues

companion_respawn.description: Recover a stalled companion entity while preserving inventory

inserter_set_filter.description: Set the filter on the nearest reachable inserter

belt_connect_start.description: Route and build transport belts between positions using carried items

session_status.description: Read server connection and latest observed game state

chat_poll.description: Read game chat after a durable cursor without consuming messages. Keep session_id; reset cursor for a new map.

wait.description: Wait briefly before inspecting a native asynchronous job
